product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires and transforms boutique professional-services firms—especially tax, accounting, and advisory practices—by equipping them with AI and technology to scale and serve clients.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as acquiring and transforming boutique service businesses and bridging AI adoption in professional services.

pricing_page.notes: The company site lists no public pricing page or pricing link in its navigation/footer.

named_customers.notes: The closest relevant page lists portfolio firms acquired by Multiplier, not customers. I found no cited customer logo wall, customer case studies, or review page identifying two customers.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 33 employees; LinkedIn lists the broader 11–50 employee range, consistent with the 21–50 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn marks Singapore as headquarters; PitchBook also identifies Singapore as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: TechCrunch reports Noah Pepper founded the company in late 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The Ideas index contains dated career and thought-leadership essays, not at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The company's navigation/footer does not link to public product documentation, a help center, or a developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Director of Product role; no AI, ML, or data-science role title is listed.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy and public Ideas articles reviewed do not identify an AI model or model provider; no provider was disclosed in the public material located.

compliance_certs.notes: The company's privacy policy does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $35 million Series B on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series B was within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists a Director of Product role, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated Ideas item is a September 2, 2026 thought-leadership essay, not a product or feature launch. The launch announcement located is from June 2025, before the six-month window; the August 2026 announcement concerned financing and hiring, not a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 2026 announcement says former Slack CFO Allen Shim joined Multiplier as President and CFO, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The current job posting is readable and does not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
